_: Little Big Questions, volcano, SILENT STORY (Sam 23 Oct 20:09: no narration; the music and the sound design carry the story; a few big words set in code; the picture explains everything). One fixed Fable view of one Cutaway block, no cuts. This beat sheet is the film's source of truth for picture, words, sound and music; facts in docs/research/KIDS_FACTS_2026-10.md 1.2 and 1.2.1. Times in seconds, 72.3 s total, timed to the music edit.

beats.name: hook
beats.picture: A sunny sea, a lifted slice of a small young volcano island floating over the hole it came from (a column of sea). The cut face shows layers of old lava and, deep down, a big magma chamber glowing and breathing, with a dark crack running up from it to the little crater. A beach ball rolls on the beach, a fizzy drink bottle stands beside a sandcastle, the snail rides a surfboard in the sea; older green islands, a boat, birds and a leaping dolphin all round.
beats.sound: sea swell, a soft breeze, gulls, a low far hum of the deep, the ball's bounce
beats.music: pianissimo creeping pizzicato theme, the whisper (recording 0:00)

beats.name: magma
beats.picture: The camera does not move; the chamber's glow swells. MAGMA appears with a gold ribbon tying it to the glowing chamber. A first glowing blob lifts off the chamber's top into the crack.
beats.sound: a deep warm rumble, a soft bubbling of thick liquid, the label's pop
beats.music: the theme keeps creeping (recording 0:05 to 0:09), ending on its rest

beats.name: rises
beats.picture: Magma is lighter than the rock round it, so it rises: glowing blobs lift off the chamber one after the other and the glowing front creeps up the crack, brightening it. The bottle's liquid wobbles slowly. Birds on the island watch from a safe distance.
beats.sound: the thick bubbling grows, a slow rising tone of rock, the sea laps
beats.music: the same theme comes back in a fuller dress and a little faster (recording 1:17 to 1:29)

beats.name: gas
beats.picture: The magma front climbs, gas bubbles appear in it and swell as they rise, like a shaken fizzy drink: the bottle on the beach is shaken, fizzing, its cap straining. The whole slice trembles a little, harder and harder, the birds lift off to the older islands and watch from there. The front reaches the crater's floor and the crater glows.
beats.sound: bubbles fizzing and popping, a growing rumble, the bottle's hiss, a bottle fizz, the trembling of stones
beats.music: the accelerando, louder and louder, more instruments joining (recording 1:29 to 1:40)

beats.name: erupt
beats.picture: WHOOSH on the orchestra's big entrance (31.4 s): lava leaps out of the TOP in a happy fountain, the bottle's cap pops and its foam leaps up at the same moment, the little sand volcano pops a puff. Now it is LAVA: glowing red and gold, it spills over the crater lip and flows down the slopes. Everyone watches from a safe distance.
beats.sound: a cork pop, a big soft whoosh, fizz and foam, the crackle of lava, a cheer of gulls
beats.music: the full orchestra enters (recording 1:40.1), then the swell at 1:42

beats.name: flows
beats.picture: The lava slides down the slopes to the sea and puffs white steam where it touches the water. Then it cools: its glow fades from gold to red to dark grey, until it is brand new rock, a black crust on the island, and the first new layer shows as a new band on the cut face. The bottle's foam settles.
beats.sound: sizzle and soft steam hiss, then quiet crackle of cooling stone, a settling thud
beats.music: the tutti theme plays on, big and warm (recording 1:42 to 1:52)

beats.name: layers
beats.picture: Time races: the clock spins, and each new eruption on the orchestra's hits adds a layer: a small fountain, a flow that cools, a new band in the cut face, the mountain a little taller. Four eruptions in six seconds.
beats.sound: a soft pop and rumble on every hit, a layer settling, the fizz of a small fountain
beats.music: the stabs: a rest, a hit, a rest, a hit (recording 2:15 to 2:20)

beats.name: growth
beats.picture: More eruptions, faster: four more hits, then the biggest of all on the final chord (56.8 s): a wide golden fountain, the mountain at its full height, a layer nobody can miss. The sea calms again after the last flow.
beats.sound: pops, a bigger whoosh, a final big rumble, then the hush
beats.music: the stabs go on, then the piece's own final crash (recording 2:28.6) and its fading chord

beats.name: rest
beats.picture: The volcano rests. Plants find a home on the new rock: a green moss at the beach first, then grass, small bushes and palms climbing the slopes while the sky softens; the top layer of the cut face turns into dark rich soil with roots. A dolphin leaps, the boat sails by, the birds come home to the palms.
beats.sound: the hush after the crash, birds, wind in leaves, sea, a dolphin's splash
beats.music: a cross-fade (film 59.1) back to the quiet theme, calm and small (recording 0:18 to 0:26)

beats.name: islands
beats.picture: The older green islands around were built the very same way: one after another each lights up with a gold ring, the chain of islands like Hawaii, and ours the youngest among them.
beats.sound: a chime for each island, the sea
beats.music: the quiet theme goes on (recording 0:26 to 0:29)

beats.name: send
beats.picture: The island settles into its gentle living loop; the snail on its surfboard waves; the closing question.
beats.words: IS THE GROUND UNDER YOUR FEET REALLY STILL?
beats.sound: gulls and the sea, a last chime
beats.music: the theme ends on its rest and a short fade (recording 0:29 to 0:31)

words_rules: Set in code (Fable lettering, large, readable on a phone, 2.5 s minimum on screen); no em dash, en dash or three dots; never drawn by a model.
sound_rules: Music is the voice of the film: foreground, not a bed (about -16 LUFS integrated, the voice slot is gone). Every event the picture shows has a sound; real CC0 recordings from the sfx-bank where they exist, tuned to the music where they are pitched. Nothing harsh, sudden or scary: soft attacks, true peak under -1.5 dBTP.

music.piece: Grieg, Peer Gynt Suite No. 1, IV. In the Hall of the Mountain King
music.edit: four cuts, each on a rest of the music, 72.3 s: recording 0:00 to 0:09.0 (the whisper); cross-fade 0.5 s into 1:17.2 to 1:52.0 (the accelerando up to the big entrance at 1:40.09 = the eruption at film 31.39, then the full orchestra); cross-fade 1.0 s into 2:14.1 to 2:31.9 (the eight orchestral hits at 2:15.15, 2:16.11, 2:19.08, 2:20.02, 2:22.95, 2:23.89, 2:24.84 and the piece's own final crash at 2:28.62 = eight more eruptions, the last the biggest); cross-fade 1.0 s into 0:17.8 to 0:31.0 (the quiet theme again for the calm); loudnorm -16 LUFS, true peak -1.5 dBTP
